_about: MPP's own dark palette (src/theme/index.ts), only the roles the new scheduling and vial components use. Values mirror the theme; the theme file stays the source of truth. bg is the opaque app background; translucent cards sit on it. New components: orange text uses accentLight (accent-text), filled buttons use primaryDark (action-fill), muted text sits on cards only. The existing white-on-primary button (3.68:1 in dark) and orange-on-white (3.18:1 in light) are pre-existing MPP pairs and are left alone.
